scientific_question: Are actual Pair-VQ residual neighbors more functionally and optimizer-path unstable than deterministic isotropic perturbations with exactly matched per-matrix energy?

early_stopped_polar_result.finding: Every strict Newton-Schulz prefix reduced error amplification only by materially changing native Muon direction and norm.

theory.paper_connection: Instantiate Mapping Loss stability on the measured codec-neighbor distribution instead of generic latent Gaussian noise.
theory.actual_neighbor: The production forward-visible center is bracketed by the symmetric Pair-VQ residual direction: native=base and plus=base+2*residual.
theory.control: For each matrix and phase, use a deterministic Rademacher direction scaled to exactly the same Frobenius energy as the Pair-VQ residual; evaluate symmetric center plus/minus controls.
theory.interpretation: Excess actual-neighbor sensitivity identifies a representation-induced path-stability defect. Equal or lower sensitivity rejects codec-neighbor stability as the causal repair.
theory.nonintervention: The dense replay remains the only training path; every neighbor is installed only inside RNG-restored evaluation/probe scopes.

frozen_protocol.training_parent: exact 124M QK-only dense-MLP synchronized replay, seed 1337, 238 updates, LR 0.0024, fixed data and schedule
frozen_protocol.logit_metric: last-token forward KL from center to each symmetric neighbor, averaged over signs and batches
frozen_protocol.functional_metric: relative error of the symmetric-neighbor average gradient against the center gradient
frozen_protocol.optimizer_metric: same dense Muon momentum, native five-step polar map, center gradient versus symmetric-neighbor average gradient

state_and_compute_contract.expected_runtime: above five minutes; terminal/error-only watchdog required

decision_rule.oracle_pass: Authorize only one zero-update codec-neighbor stability-gradient alignment oracle. Training remains forbidden until that gradient aligns with the dense-minus-compact vector-field discrepancy on held-out phases.
decision_rule.oracle_fail: Reject codec-neighbor Mapping Loss stability as the primary repair and return to a norm-preserving spectrally damped polar discriminator.
